description: This Java source file defines the MainActivity class for an Android application. It sets up a grid-based launcher interface that displays sample activities, allowing users to select and navigate to different features within the app. It includes inner classes for managing sample data and adapter logic for populating the UI.

classes.name: MainActivity
classes.description: The main launcher activity that displays a grid of samples for user navigation.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the activity, sets up the grid view with sample items, and links click handling.

methods.name: onItemClick
methods.description: Handles user clicks on grid items by launching the associated sample activity.
